Huliaipole Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zaporizhia Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. During the Civil War, Huliaipole was the center of Nestor Makhno's anarchist 'Free Territory' — Makhno himself opposed antisemitism and tried to prevent pogroms, and Jews were among the anarchist movement's own leaders, a distinctive counter-narrative for this turbulent period. In the 1920s, the Huliaipole Jewish National Raion encompassed 14 village councils and about 20,000 residents, 70 percent of them Jewish — one of at least three such Jewish national administrative districts documented in this collection, alongside Kalinindorf and Novozlatopil. Most of the Jews who remained after the German arrival in October 1941 were killed that January.
